```artifact
Feature: Update Information in System

  Scenario: Admin updates doctor's information
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates the doctor's information with valid details
    Then the doctor's information should be updated successfully

  Scenario: Admin updates lab/chemist's information
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates the lab/chemist's information with valid details
    Then the lab/chemist's information should be updated successfully

  Scenario: Patient updates personal details
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient updates their personal details with valid information
    Then the patient's details should be updated successfully

  Scenario: Patient creates an appointment
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient creates an appointment for a future date
    Then the appointment should be created and visible in the appointments tab

  Scenario Outline: Admin updates doctor's information with invalid details
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates the doctor's information with <invalid_details>
    Then the update should fail with error message "<error_message>"

    Examples:
      | invalid_details                | error_message                |
      | name: ""                       | Name cannot be empty         |
      | email: "invalid-email"         | Invalid email format         |
      | phone: "1234567890"            | Phone number must be 10 digits |

  Scenario Outline: Admin updates lab/chemist's information with invalid details
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates the lab/chemist's information with <invalid_details>
    Then the update should fail with error message "<error_message>"

    Examples:
      | invalid_details                | error_message                |
      | name: ""                       | Name cannot be empty         |
      | email: "invalid-email"         | Invalid email format         |
      | phone: "1234567890"            | Phone number must be 10 digits |

  Scenario Outline: Patient updates personal details with invalid details
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient updates their personal details with <invalid_details>
    Then the update should fail with error message "<error_message>"

    Examples:
      | invalid_details                | error_message                |
      | name: ""                       | Name cannot be empty         |
      | email: "invalid-email"         | Invalid email format         |
      | phone: "1234567890"            | Phone number must be 10 digits |

  Scenario Outline: Patient creates an appointment with invalid date
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient tries to create an appointment for a past date
    Then the appointment creation should fail with error message "<error_message>"

    Examples:
      | past_date                      | error_message                |
      | 2020-01-01                     | Appointment date cannot be in the past |
```

  {"id": "TC-003", "title": "Patient updates personal details", "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-5-5"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["patient is logged in"], "inputs": {"name": "Jane Doe", "email": "jane.doe@example.com"}, "steps": ["patient updates personal details with valid information"], "expected": ["patient's details should be updated successfully"]},

  {"id": "TC-008", "title": "Patient creates an appointment with invalid date", "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-5-7"], "kind": "negative",
   "preconditions": ["patient is logged in"], "inputs": {"date": "2020-01-01"}, "steps": ["patient tries to create an appointment for a past date"], "expected": ["appointment creation should fail with error message 'Appointment date cannot be in the past'"]}
